svg.text: 10 Final fit, doors and lighting test
BED v9 | build order | assembly / installation view
BEDROOM WORKSHOP | mm | verify stock and purchased hardware before cutting | revision 2026-11-15
All pictured panel IDs are listed in the native
BuildOrder sheet and CutSchedule. This is the
assembled module, not an exploded part detail.
1. Anchor and level both towers; install bridge and headboard, then position bed platform.
2. Adjust hinges/front gaps. Fit ceiling scribe on site; maintain finger access.
3. Test each lighting branch before fitting diffusers. Follow the wiring page next.
4. Install mattress only after drawer travel, retention straps and final fixings pass.
